# Browser dependencies

Copied from the user's existing Preferences website, with their upstream licenses:

- Lucide: https://lucide.dev/ — icon library, ISC license; Lucide-LICENSE.txt.
- QRCode.js: https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs — local QR rendering, MIT license; QRCode-LICENSE.txt.

These files are served locally. The application does not send QR contents to a remote service. Firebase is separately imported from the official Google CDN only in configured live mode.
